verdict.rationale: Feitian's own iePassManager app is documented to manage FIDO devices, including PIN and 'credential related operations', which plausibly covers deleting credentials stored on the key. The docs also state biometric data never leaves the key. Neither explicitly describes deleting credentials or fingerprints, or any retention controls. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of credential/fingerprint deletion or factory reset, any retention-control description, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion

citations.quote: Learn how to use iePassManager at Android OS to manage your FIDO devices(including FIDO PIN and credential related operations).
The fingerprint is matched entirely on-device, so your biometric data never leaves the key
